items.note: S1.3 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network on triples, three stages, (X,Y)->(-Y,X) and restoration of every scratch wire, matching Lemma lem:scalar-motifs. It omits h=100, the neighbour rules and the per-invocation result y_S <- y_S + x_S (net change (JV+RG)x) on which the three-stage exchange rests.

S1.4 gives frames per vertex, commutation with pointwise gates and the endpoint operator D_sink D_source^{-1} on a route. It does not state the edge operator D_v D_u^{-1} or D_out S D_in^{-1}, and it drops the route sign epsilon_w, which matters for the complex network.

S1.5 states comparable nondegenerate labels, central-wire returns as the only decreasing edges (the paper's own word, line 952), the sum Wm-2N+2L and L<N/2. It leaves out the ambient space F^{⊗3}, the loss of h per decreasing edge, L=Ich and the exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539.

Statement matches Prop. prop:bit-motif-interface: projections P_U, -P_{U_a} at the X sources, endpoint difference I_m, and s=Wm-N+2L<Wm. The method's claim that every edge rank equals the dimension change misses the N source edges of rank one (dimension change zero), which is exactly what turns -2N into -N (lines 1160-1166). The check P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m is also not shown.

S2.1 gives the phase frames C_U, one translation kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c<W_c m and C^{⊗m} on every role. It omits s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and it says the network realises C^{⊗m} without the source/sink Z corrections and the undoing of the signed bank exchange that the paper needs (lines 1225-1227, 1295-1314).

The plan has L<N/2, s<Wm, a deficit above 20·2^{-50} and tau=1-2^{-50} with s/W<m^tau for the bit network. It gives neither eta value, omits the log m<20 step that turns the deficit into the exponent, and never states the complex counterpart s_c/W_c<m^sigma. Rated stated rather than derived because S1.6.2 gives only the bare reason.
S1.1 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S1.2 drops the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (and that q be a fixed prime), which is part of Lemma lem:ordered-affine-streams.
Both lemmas are stated accurately: E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones, and exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Neither the elimination proof nor the three-update implementation of each Pi entry is given.

These steps follow the proof of Prop. prop:power-interchange: cyclic row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} on every edge through recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, s calls on volume V/W, the recurrence and geometric sum, and the parked-stack fixed-tape schedule at O(V) per node.

S1 gives the permutation (p,h,g,d,z)->(p,d,g,h,z) and the O(Vu^tau) bound, and S1.10 sketches high digits as rows, padding and power-width calls. That matches the lemma, though the base-m decomposition is not described.

S2.2 (s_c children on f=e/m axes per slot, C^{⊗e} on every role) and S2.3 (H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D) are correct. The conjugation by P_M that moves residual directions to coordinate slots and the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z are missing; binary basis changes appear only as what S2.4 serves.

The XOR of selected bits by whole-chunk cyclic shifts plus a sorting repair of a bad set, restoring z, is correct in substance. The step says only 'a few' shifts (the paper uses eight), gives no delta_bad and quotes only the parameter-family cost O(V(L^tau+1)) without its conditions.

The recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and its O(d^{lambda'}) outcome are correctly given. The leaf cost F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the condition a<=m^sigma, the overhead bound K<=e^{c/beta}, the base-m pieces and the condition on lambda' are all missing.

S2's method and sub-steps follow the paper's proof: phase-frame children, row split, packed basis changes, recurrence, conversion by eq:phase-butterfly-layer, exact guard bits and one truncation with error <sqrt2·2^{-p}. Missing are the requirement epsilon·C_1<1 that makes Delta=o(p) (the width stays O(p)) and the uniformity check of the packed-call cost over the bands (lines 2690-2734).

Bit-reversed storage, signed-shift twiddles, the layout L with O(p/K) chunk exchanges and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]) are right. Missing are character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error sqrt2·l·2^{-p}.
S3.4 matches: evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the established multiplier, centered residues and O(rp log(rp)). The normalised output Q_p(fg/r) is left implicit.

The statement (error sqrt2·M(3l+1)2^{-p}, cost) and the procedure (two forward transforms in the retained LB order, pointwise packed products, opposite transform, exact scaling by M) follow the proof. The normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M F^-f·F^-g and the error accumulation that gives 3l+1 are not shown.

The identities P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and RF_s=2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A, the costs and the error p^2 are correct. S4.1 drops the hypothesis theta>p/alpha^4 (which appears only later, in S5.1.2) and does not define the permutations P_s and P_t.
The chirp identity and the cancellation (RF^+)[(RFu)(RFv)]=(u*v)/S^2 match. RF^+R=F^+ is equivalent to the paper's F^+R=R^{-1}F^+.

Sizes, the prime interval, T/2<S<T and alpha^4·theta>p are correct. Missing are the fixed rational values (epsilon, c, lambda, lambda', delta), eta=1/(4d), alpha and gamma, and the verification of the exponent conditions.
The algebra isomorphism and triangular controlled shifts are correct. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the triangular formula b_i and the cost are not given.
x -> zeta·y with coefficientwise zeta^k, negative wrap turned into the cyclic wrap, and f*g/T as M_r conjugated by the twist: all match.

The source-transform composition and the six steps follow the paper's construction. S5 states the scalings as 'S and 2^{2b+4}' instead of S and 2^{2b+4}S, and the plan omits the digit scaling 2^{-b-2} and the construction of F^+ by conjugation.
E_s=9·2^gamma·TL, the final bound 448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries are right. The intermediate E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28·2^gamma·T^2L and the use of gamma<=b/4 are not shown.

These steps follow the paper: normalised costs from Table tab:costs, margins with minimum g_2=epsilon·c·(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa, setup and exceptional streams o(Tp), and log powers absorbed into p^kappa.
S8 correctly gives liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 against the eventual lower bound.

errors.says: Assigning P_U at each vertex and -P_{U_a} at the sources makes each edge rank equal to the label dimension change.
errors.paper: The N source edges of X_a are exceptions: their edge matrix 2P_{U_a} has rank one where the dimension change is zero. That is why s_b=Wm-N+2L and not Wm-2N+2L. The negative matrix is also assigned only at the X_a sources; every other source gets zero.

errors.says: The whole network realises C^{⊗m} on every role.
errors.paper: On X_a -> Y_a the telescoped frame gives C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a). C^{⊗m} is obtained only after the source/sink Z_{a,k} corrections, the scalar i^{27k}, negation of the X outputs and undoing the exchange.

errors.says: For gcd(s,t)=1 and s<t there are contractions A, B_0 with the stated identity and approximations.
errors.paper: The lemma also requires theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4, 2<=alpha<sqrt p, p>100 and t<2^p.
The second scaling multiplies by 2^{2b+4}S, so S enters twice and undoes the 1/S^2 normalization.

chain: The plan follows the paper's route to the main bound: interchange recurrence (S1), simultaneous layer (S2), synthetic convolution (S3), resampling and chirp (S4), the CRT and twist reduction and algorithm (S5), precision (S6) and time accounting (S7). The interchange recurrence and the final accounting are given in full. The rank budget is thin: the source-edge exception that turns Wm-2N+2L into Wm-N+2L is missing, and so is log m<20, which turns the deficit into tau. The layer, transform and resampling stages are mostly asserted rather than derived.

steps.note: The exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with restored scratch wires on a triple network is stated, but h=100, the triple-indexed banks, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent. Rated conservatively for the missing quantities.
Frames commute with pointwise gates, a route applies only D_sink D_source^{-1}, and S1.9.1 applies a shear frame on each edge. The sign epsilon_w is omitted.

Comparable nondegenerate labels with only central-wire returns decreasing are stated. The ambient space F^{⊗3} of dimension m and the loss of h per decreasing edge are missing, so the step is rated conservatively.
Projection matrices whose edge rank equals the dimension change are named. The N rank-one source edges, the stated exception, are missing, and the plan's claim covers every edge.
Both Wm-2N+2L and s=Wm-N+2L are stated, though L=Ich is not.
L<N/2 is used to give s<Wm. The exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are not given.
The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every row are both stated.
E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node are all present.
Volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from a deficit above 20·2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all present. The log m<20 step is omitted.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the recursive end of the central saving: endpoint identity, shear factorization into rank-many calls, the recurrence and the exponent. It also carries the budget formulas and L<N/2. The construction end is thinner: the fixed network lacks h, N and m, the labels lack the per-edge loss h, and the rank-equals-dimension step omits the N rank-one source edges that turn Wm-2N+2L into Wm-N+2L.
